alkylation_concentration.evidence: and alkylated with 40 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) for 30 min at 25 °C, 300 rpm, in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: and alkylated with 40 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) for 30 min at 25 °C, 300 rpm, in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested in 50 mM TEAB containing trypsin (Promega) at a 1:20 enzyme-to-protein ratio overnight at 37 °C, 1000 rpm.

enrichment_method.evidence: Residual samples were subjected to phosphopeptide enrichment according to the EasyPhos protocol (Humphrey et al, 2018). Briefly, sample volumes were adjusted to 800 µl with water and subsequently to final 228 mM KCl, 3.9 mM KH2PO4, 38% [v/v] ACN, 4.5% [v/v] trifluoroacetic acid (TFA). 15 mg TiO2 beads (GL Sciences) in 80% [v/v] ACN, 6% [v/v] TFA were added (beads-to-protein ratio of 10:1).

fractionation_method.evidence: inferred: The first 6 min were collected as flow-through (FT), followed by 48 x 1 min fractions, which were reduced to 12 fractions by concatenated pooling.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Dried peptide samples were dissolved in 2% [v/v] ACN, 0.1% [v/v] TFA and injected onto a C18 PepMap100-trapping column (Thermo Scientific, 0.3 x 5 mm, 5 µm) connected to an in-house packed C18 analytical column (Dr. Maisch GmbH, 75 µm x 300 mm).

labeling.evidence: TMTsixplex (Thermo Scientific) labeling was performed using three labeling batches according to manufacturer’s instructions.

ptm.evidence: fixed modification, carbamidomethylation (C); variable modifications, oxidation (M), acetylation (N-term), phosphorylation (S,T,Y) (only for phosphopeptide data).
